watch_items.status_at_snapshot: C2026C00405, 16 September 2026 compilation; verify changes and temporal application
watch_items.expected_trigger: New CCA compilation, amending Act or commencement affecting a standing consumer or competition assessment
watch_items.status_at_review: Latest compilation is C2026C00486 (compilation 168, 27 October 2026). Its only new amendment is the Telecommunications Legislation Amendment (Universal Outdoor Mobile Obligation) Act 2026 (No. 100, 2026) sch 1 item 1, which amends s 151BC(2)(c) in Part XIC and does not touch the ACL. Separately, the Treasury Laws Amendment (Doubling Penalties for ACCC Enforcement) Act 2026 (No. 19, 2026) commenced on 28 March 2026 and replaced the $50,000,000 fixed amount with $100,000,000 in ss 45AF(3)(a), 45AG(3)(a) and 76(1B)(a) and in the listed ACL penalty provisions, including s 224(3A)(a), for conduct on or after that date
watch_items.review_basis: legislation.gov.au version list and the as-made text of Acts No. 100 and No. 19 of 2026 read on 2026-11-16; ACL ss 23 and 224 read in compilation 168

watch_items.status_at_review: Still proposed only. The Treasury ministerial release of 19 September 2026 is now readable: it released a consultation regulation impact statement on post-market product safety (submissions 21 September to 18 October 2026) and records that in July 2026 Consumer Ministers agreed broader product safety reforms remain a priority, including consideration of general safety protections. It mentions no Bill or exposure draft. Compilation 168 (27 October 2026) adds only an amendment to s 151BC(2)(c), outside the ACL
